requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide a `/domain-workbench` application surface that lists all three registered reference DomainContext bundles, shows read-only model sources, groups semantic resources, and lets users filter operations by owner, behavior, subject, invocation, and effect without editing Kon model source.

case.given: the production server registers the event, commerce, and organization reference bundles
case.then: the workbench SHALL load all three bundle ids and select a stable default bundle

case.given: a selected bundle catalog with Kon model sources
case.then: the model text SHALL be visible as read-only content and no upload or recompile control SHALL be exposed

case.given: the operation catalog contains BO, association, lifecycle, constraint, process, capability, domain-context, and raw owners
case.then: the visible operation list SHALL update without mutating the selected preset request

requirement.statement: The Workbench SHALL project day-level timeline controls only from the currently valid complete request in the JSON editor, SHALL apply control edits by replacing `request.timeline` in that same JSON text, and SHALL NOT maintain separate date, timeline, payload, subject, execution, or request authority.

case.given: valid as-of, effective-on, and range preset requests
case.when: each request is selected or manually edited
case.then: the Workbench SHALL show only the day inputs owned by that request mode with values derived from the editor

case.given: a valid temporal request and a changed day input
case.then: the editor SHALL contain the edited complete request and the POST body SHALL be exactly that current JSON value

case.given: invalid JSON, request schema, calendar day, range, or catalog-owned facts in the editor
case.when: timeline controls and execution state render
case.then: interactive timeline controls and execution SHALL be unavailable, diagnostics SHALL be path-aware, and the editor text SHALL remain unchanged

requirement.statement: The Workbench SHALL execute organization snapshot, adjustment apply, constraint failure, and independent transfer batch presets through the standard execute route and SHALL render their existing tree, mutation, probe, plan, item mapping, and diagnostic response facts without a temporal-domain-specific response model.

case.given: an organization snapshot preset whose as-of day is changed in the timeline control
case.then: the posted body SHALL contain the edited day and the tree outcome SHALL reflect that requested temporal slice

case.given: successful apply, atomic business failure, and best-effort partial organization presets
case.then: the standard result tabs SHALL expose truthful status, changes, before/after, trace, plan, item mapping, and diagnostics

requirement.statement: The timeline strip and its mode-specific date controls SHALL remain bounded and usable with the existing request and response surfaces on desktop and mobile, without horizontal page overflow, incoherent overlap, unexpected console errors, or regression of the Kon IDE route.

case.given: desktop and mobile viewport sizes with organization as-of and range requests
case.when: timeline controls, editor, execute action, and response tabs render
case.then: all primary controls SHALL remain within the viewport and SHALL NOT overlap adjacent interactive regions
